package domain

import "encoding/json"

// TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan is transient deterministic policy output.
// It contains no raw Planner reason, graph identifier, Student profile or path
// identifier. The body and optional UI are the only user-visible projection.
type TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan struct {
	Status      TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status
	Phase       TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase
	StateRef    TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef
	Step        TeacherOnboardingStep
	DisplayName string
	Body        string
	AssistantUI json.RawMessage
}

func BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(readiness TeacherLearningReadiness, state TeacherStudentOnboardingState, studentID, locale string) (TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan, error) {
	normalizedState, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingState(state, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, err
	}
	expected, err := TeacherReadinessStateRefFromOnboarding(normalizedState, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, err
	}
	readiness, err = NormalizeTeacherLearningReadiness(readiness, &expected)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, err
	}
	if locale != "en" {
		locale = "ru"
	}
	reason := readiness.ReasonCodes[0]
	plan := TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{StateRef: readiness.StateRef}
	switch readiness.Result {
	case TeacherLearningReadinessReady:
		plan.Status, plan.Phase = TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart
		switch reason {
		case TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved:
			plan.DisplayName = TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName
		case TeacherReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved:
			plan.DisplayName = TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName
		default:
			return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		}
		if locale == "en" {
			plan.Body = "There is enough information to prepare the “" + plan.DisplayName + "” path. No path, course, or lessons have been created yet."
		} else {
			plan.Body = "Данных достаточно для подготовки пути «" + plan.DisplayName + "». Путь, курс и уроки ещё не созданы."
		}
		return plan, nil
	case TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady:
		switch reason {
		case TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists:
			plan.Status, plan.Phase = TeacherOnboardingSessionActivePathExists, TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart
			if locale == "en" {
				plan.Body = "Your existing learning path is preserved unchanged. No new path, course, or lessons have been created."
			} else {
				plan.Body = "Ваш существующий учебный путь сохранён без изменений. Новый путь, курс или уроки не создавались."
			}
			return plan, nil
		case TeacherReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported:
			plan.Step = OnboardingStepDirection
			if locale == "en" {
				plan.Body = "This combination is not supported yet. I can prepare Programming Fundamentals when you are undecided, or Go backend when you explicitly choose backend and Go. Please choose the direction you want to use."
			} else {
				plan.Body = "Эта комбинация пока не поддерживается. Я могу подготовить «Основы программирования» для варианта «Не знаю» или Go backend при явном выборе backend и Go. Выберите направление, которое хотите использовать."
			}
		case TeacherReadinessReasonPublishedGraphUnavailable:
			return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		default:
			return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		}
	case TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification:
		switch reason {
		case TeacherReadinessReasonStudentStateMissing, TeacherReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing:
			plan.Step = OnboardingStepGoal
		case TeacherReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete:
			if normalizedState.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience == nil {
				plan.Step = OnboardingStepExperience
			} else if normalizedState.Draft.DirectionCode == nil {
				plan.Step = OnboardingStepDirection
			} else {
				return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
			}
		case TeacherReadinessReasonContentLanguageUntrusted:
			plan.Step = OnboardingStepLanguage
		case TeacherReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved, TeacherReadinessReasonMultipleDesiredStacks:
			if normalizedState.Draft.DirectionCode == nil {
				plan.Step = OnboardingStepDirection
			} else if *normalizedState.Draft.DirectionCode == "backend" {
				plan.Step = OnboardingStepDesiredStack
			} else {
				return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
			}
		case TeacherReadinessReasonProfileContradictory:
			if normalizedState.Draft.DirectionCode != nil && *normalizedState.Draft.DirectionCode == "backend" {
				plan.Step = OnboardingStepDesiredStack
			} else {
				plan.Step = OnboardingStepDirection
			}
		default:
			return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		}
	default:
		return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	plan.Status = TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting
	switch plan.Step {
	case OnboardingStepGoal:
		plan.Phase = TeacherOnboardingPhaseGettingAcquainted
	case OnboardingStepExperience, OnboardingStepDirection, OnboardingStepLanguage:
		plan.Phase = TeacherOnboardingPhaseDeterminingStart
	case OnboardingStepDesiredStack:
		plan.Phase = TeacherOnboardingPhasePreparingPath
	default:
		return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	promptBody, assistantUI, err := BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(plan.Step, locale, normalizedState.Draft.Version)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan{}, err
	}
	if plan.Body == "" {
		plan.Body = promptBody
	}
	plan.AssistantUI = assistantUI
	return plan, nil
}
